headline: A quiet day with no new scored events
body: No new events were scored today. Every ending moved by less than 0.1 point as the effect of earlier announcements slowly faded, a routine drift of up to 0.05. Horizon Balance held at 1.85. Nothing changed in the underlying world factors.
movers_note: Only small drifts as earlier news faded: Protector God -0.05 and Enslaved God -0.05.
